Specification: This module models a very small library-style specification containing a single identity operator. The comments indicate that the purpose of the file is to illustrate an overly general polymorphic type annotation for the operator, namely that a library author wrote a type that is too general and a type checker should reject it. The specification does not define any state variables, actions, temporal behavior, fault model, or correctness properties; it is purely a functional definition used to expose a typing issue.
